previous_statement: Quantifier and universality closure. The witnesses eta_A,C_A,C_E,epsilon_E and hence W_RF were fixed once before the input was chosen. The input H,Phi,eta was arbitrary in the root domain, while only B,v,u,S were selected after that input. Universal introduction over H,Phi,eta followed by existential introduction of the one fixed W_RF and the input-dependent B,v,S therefore gives exactly the quantifier order, independence assertions, fields, and conclusions of root node 1.
new_statement: Quantifier and universality closure, as a logical implication. If eta_A,C_A,C_E,epsilon_E and hence W_RF are chosen once independently of all inputs, and if for an arbitrary H,Phi,eta in the root domain the input-dependent B,v,u,S and all displayed conclusions are obtained, then universal generalization over H,Phi,eta followed by existential introduction of the single fixed W_RF and the input-dependent B,v,S gives exactly the quantifier order and independence assertions of root node 1.
